title: Identification of novel lipid metabolism-related biomarkers of aortic dissection by integrating single-cell RNA sequencing analysis and machine learning algorithms.
summary: The full paper combines single-cell data, machine-learning prioritization and bulk RNA-seq validation to identify PLIN2/PLIN3 in aortic dissection; PLIN2 expression is further checked in an Ang-II mouse model. This supports a limited lipid-metabolism/immune association result, not a validated therapy target.
